text:
jess_h: Heads up — MeterWise renewal quote showed up, and it jumped ~28% vs current effective rate. Any negotiation levers? @procurement
procurement: Can you paste the quote and current spend breakdown?
mike_finance: Also need last 6 months usage by SKU. jess_h can you share that?
jess_h: Quick snapshot of the key lines: 
```
SKU: MW-GEN-TOKENS
Usage (last 30d): 2.4B tokens
Current effective rate: $0.0075/token (~$18k/mo)
Quoted renewal list: $0.0095/token (~$23k/mo)
Additional: ingestion meter + realtime meter approx $3k/mo
```
procurement: Hmm — MeterWise has volume tiers. Did they apply committed tier pricing or just list rates? If it's list we can ask for blended/committed pricing.
ben_eng: We're using their realtime ingestion for telemetry and also a direct call for inference logs. Could we reduce ingestion granularity to lower meter? ops impact?
sara_ops: Sampling logs is OK for non-billing telemetry but we need full fidelity for throttling alerts. Sampling might be acceptable for meter stream if config is per-env.
procurement: I'll kick off negotiation. Options to ask for: 1) a committed volume discount 2) a blended transition rate 3) a one-time credit for the Feb duplicate charges that looked like double-billing.
jess_h: Important: avoid a multi-week migration if possible. If switching vendors (CostSpectrum/PricePilot) is faster for price, still weigh integration risk.
olivia_vendor: Hi all — Olivia from MeterWise. Thanks for flagging. We can offer a 12-month term with a 15% discount off list if you commit to 2.5B tokens/mo, or a 6-month ramp with a 10% discount and a usage cap. Regarding Feb, I see a support ticket; we'll investigate and issue a credit for duplicate events once validated.
mike_finance: 15% looks good but need explicit cap + overage protection and a billing accuracy SLA. Also request line-item credits for any confirmed overcharges.
olivia_vendor: Understood. We can add a billing SLA (time-to-credit <=30 days for confirmed errors), a capped overage tier at 150% of committed volume, and per-invoice line-item credits. I'll prepare a revised quote with a credit for the Feb incident and a sample migration plan for sampling of ingestion.
procurement: Can you also add per-model tagging support so we can cost-allocate across product teams? That affects how we accept the quote.
olivia_vendor: Yes — we support per-model and per-team tagging via the x-meterwise-tag header and a cost mapping export.
ben_eng: Need to confirm they can tag at request-level (not just tenant). Otherwise allocations will be wrong.
olivia_vendor: Confirmed: request-level tags supported; SDK and header-based tagging both available.
jess_h: Great. Procurement — please push for a refundable ramp (90-day checkpoint) and a 30-day out clause at quarter boundaries in case usage falls off.
procurement: Will request a 90-day review window with a pro-rata termination clause and require billing audit access. Also will ask for a short SLA for billing disputes.
mike_finance: Created PO-REQ-4987 in internal system as a placeholder to speed approvals once quote is final.
procurement: I'll ask MeterWise for a side-letter with the credits and the SLA and also request written confirmation of the duplicate-billing credit by EOD.
olivia_vendor: I'll send a revised quote and the side-letter with credit details and SLA today EOD. Also can include a comparison sheet vs. CostSpectrum and PricePilot cost models if helpful.
jess_h: Thanks — please cc me. :thumbsup:
procurement: Following up — I've asked CS to pull 12-month cost comps from PricePilot and CostSpectrum for parity checks; priority is getting the Feb credit + SLA. Will update thread when quote lands.
procurement: Update: vendor confirmed credit for Feb duplicate (will show as a negative line on next invoice) and sent revised quote with 12% effective discount and billing SLA. Reviewing now.
mike_finance: I'll validate the math and confirm impact to monthly burn and Q-level forecasting.
procurement: Next steps: wait for final quote doc, review with finance, then route PO for signature. If anyone objects to the negotiated terms (12% + SLA + 90-day checkpoint), speak now.
ben_eng: Sounds acceptable from eng side as long as tagging + request-level support is documented in the side-letter.
jess_h: Agreed. Thanks everyone.
